'''Holodarts''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] game in existence<ref name="Orbit" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Orbit Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> The [[Lean Nuuti Bar and Grill]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], located on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[StarForge Station]], had a game of holodarts. Sometime early in the year it was played by a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] when the formerly [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', whose crew had recently [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutinied]] from under Imperial control,<ref name="Orbit" /> was docked at the space station.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Holodarts first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'',<ref name="Orbit" /> and had the same theme of the previous publication ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
